preconditions.description: The number of problems n must be between 1 and 100000.
The number of experienced teams k must be between 1 and 4.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == k and all(x in {0, 1} for x in row) for row in problems)
preconditions.description: Each of the n lines must contain exactly k integers, each being either 0 or 1.

postconditions.description: The output must be either 'YES' or 'NO' in any case variation.

postconditions.expression: any(all(sum(row[i] for i in selected) <= len(selected) // 2 for row in problems) for selected in combinations(range(n), r) for r in range(1, n + 1))
postconditions.description: There exists a non-empty subset of problems such that each team knows at most half of the selected problems.
